script.problem: It has 36 words. A meaning is about 30 words at most.
It has 3 sentences. A meaning is 1 or 2 sentences.

terra.problem: The people living in Jesus’ time were not themselves settled there by Assyria’s king; the sources describe earlier settlers and their descendants. Also, “mixed with the Jews’ land” is unclear: Easton says the settlers mixed with Jews who remained in the land.
